dimensions.assessment: Affects all current and prospective holders of National Flood Insurance Program policies, participating insurers, and property owners in flood zones nationwide.
dimensions.evidence: Enter into, issue, or renew contracts for flood insurance... Continue in force existing flood insurance coverage.

dimensions.assessment: Prevents program lapses by automatically extending flood insurance issuance, policy renewals, and claims processing authorities past standard expiration dates.
dimensions.evidence: The authorities described in paragraph (2) shall be automatically extended until the last day of the fiscal year following the terminal fiscal year

dimensions.assessment: Extends existing funding availability, borrowing authority limits, and authorization of appropriations at current terms and conditions during extension periods.
dimensions.evidence: Any authorization of appropriations or other funding availability under this title that would otherwise expire on the termination date shall... be available at the same level

dimensions.assessment: Amends section 1319 of the National Flood Insurance Act of 1968 to replace the current expiration framework with an automatic contingent extension rule.
dimensions.evidence: Section 1319 of the National Flood Insurance Act of 1968 (42 U.S.C. 4026) is amended to read as follows

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent structural rule for program continuation with a retroactive effective date of September 30, 2025.
dimensions.evidence: This section shall take effect as if enacted on September 30, 2025.

importance_detail.rationale: Amends the National Flood Insurance Act of 1968 to establish an automatic contingent extension mechanism for the National Flood Insurance Program through the end of the subsequent fiscal year upon expiration.
